fullPassage: Situational ethics is an ethical theory that takes into account the context of a situation or an act when judging whether it is ethical. Supporters of this theory willingly permit casting aside absolute moral standards. In the absence of a universal standard or law, what matters is the outcome or consequences; so, the end justifies the means. Possibly the following contrasting realities can help illustrate the application of situational ethics. In a pickup game of basketball played among friends, everyone is expected to call his or her own fouls or acknowledge knocking the ball out-of-bounds. Caring about one's friends and maybe getting to keep playing with the group leads to these actions. But, once an organized game is played with officials, most athletes will not admit to the same fouls or violations as the end goal of winning is more important than expressing concern for competitors. Situational ethics has been extended by many athletes and coaches to mean trying to get away with as many actions on the field or court as possible to abandon competitive advantages.

❌ ② every action requires careful deliberation (신중한 심의): 본문에 관련 언급 없음

❌ ③ individual intentions determine ethical value (의도가 윤리 가치 결정): '의도'가 아닌 '결과(outcome)' 중시

✅ ④ the end justifies the means (목적이 수단을 정당화): 'what matters is the outcome; so, ____'에서 결과 중요 → 목적이 수단을 정당화 ← 정답
det.tip: 빈칸 앞: 결과가 중요 → 빈칸: the end justifies the means = 목적이 수단을 정당화

questions.passage: Situational ethics is an ethical theory that takes into account the context of a situation or an act when judging whether it is ethical. Supporters of this theory willingly permit __________. In the absence of a universal standard or law, what matters is the outcome or consequences; so, the end justifies the means. Possibly the following contrasting realities can help illustrate the application of situational ethics. In a pickup game of basketball played among friends, everyone is expected to call his or her own fouls or acknowledge knocking the ball out-of-bounds. Caring about one's friends and maybe getting to keep playing with the group leads to these actions. But, once an organized game is played with officials, most athletes will not admit to the same fouls or violations as the end goal of winning is more important than expressing concern for competitors. Situational ethics has been extended by many athletes and coaches to mean trying to get away with as many actions on the field or court as possible to abandon competitive advantages.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: promoting fair play among all athletes
respecting every competitor on the field

det.korean: ① 엄격한 보편적 규제 시행 — 오답, ② 절대 기준 제쳐놓기 — 정답, ③ 페어플레이 촉진 — 오답, ④ 경쟁자 존중 — 오답
det.analysis:
❌ ① enforcing strict universal regulations: 상황 윤리는 보편적 기준 부재를 전제. 정반대

✅ ② casting aside absolute moral standards: 'Supporters ~ willingly permit ____' → 절대 기준 폐기. 다음 문장 'In the absence of a universal standard'와 연결 ← 정답

❌ ③ promoting fair play among all athletes: 공식 경기에서 페어플레이가 줄어든다는 내용과 상충

❌ ④ respecting every competitor on the field: 승리가 상대 배려보다 중요하다는 내용과 상충

det.analysis:
❌ ① will always confess their mistakes: 공식 경기에서 정직이 최고라는 내용은 대비 구조와 정반대

❌ ② tend to follow the same informal rules: But(그러나)으로 시작하므로 비공식 경기와 대조되어야 함. 같은 규칙 따른다면 대비 아님

❌ ③ prefer to let officials make all decisions: 심판에게 모든 것 맡긴다는 내용 본문에 없음

✅ ④ will not admit to the same fouls or violations as the end goal of winning is more important than expressing concern for competitors: But 대비 구조. 비공식(파울 인정) ↔ 공식(파울 불인정) ← 정답
det.tip: But 대비 구조: 비공식 경기(파울 인정) ↔ 공식 경기(파울 불인정). 승리 > 배려
